name: MIND REAPER
source:
The world with sudden mass riots are a usual thing. Mind Reapers are people who are presumed to be the cause of sudden mass riots.

Main character is a student who gets attacked by a group of trained men one day. His classmate girl  comes out to help protagonist with words "it's not a fight for ordinary humans" and defeats opponents one by one. What's the reason for attack? What is the true nature of the girl? The girl promises to protect protagonist, but it's only the first in the chain of events.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界，突发大规模骚乱早已司空见惯。人们认为，这些事件是被称为“Mind Reaper”的人所引发。

主人公是一名学生，一天遭到一群训练有素的男子袭击。同班女生说着“这不是普通人能参与的战斗”，现身相救，将敌人逐一击败。主人公为何遭到袭击？少女的真实身份又是什么？她承诺保护主人公，但这只是连串事件的开端。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
